edit.description: `STATE_ROOT_NAMES.tickVerdict` becomes the directory; `tickVerdictPath` takes the phase
the pre-tick clear: the named phase's file under `--phase`, the whole directory for a bare tick, which has no sibling child by construction
the child's verdict read opens the file it named the child by
the ignore entry gains the trailing slash its directory siblings carry — a bare `tick-verdict.json` line ignores no directory
the path rule and the runtime-ignore set

summary: One verdict path for every supervisor child is silently lossy above `maxTicks` 1; key the file by phase

per.section: The tick verdict — one facts artifact

acceptance: each child writes and the supervisor reads `<flumeDir>/tick-verdict/<phase>.json`; two children of one run never share a verdict path, and the directory is ignored
tests: two ticks of different phases each leave their own verdict file
the runtime ignore set names the verdict directory, not a verdict file
notes: Ruled 2026-09-24 (inbox), first fork: a phase never runs twice at once and the supervisor names each child's phase, so the reader opens the file it named the child by — no new contract, no inference. This is the gate on raising this repo's `maxTicks`. `spec/jobs.md`'s runtime-ignore listing still spells the file; carried in the open question on spec sentences that trail shipped behavior.
